versions.changelog:
- Expanded and reorganized documentation to clarify credential, config path, and external connection requirements.
- Added detailed tables summarizing required credentials, storage locations, privacy policy, and external services used.
- Included a manifest summary section for transparent disclosure of all runtime secrets and config paths.
- Improved consistency in documentation links and contact information.
- No changes to plugin logic or code in this release (documentation update only).

- Initial public release of claw-messenger v1.0.0.
- Provides a plugin for OpenClaw agents to send and receive iMessage, RCS, and SMS without a physical device or Mac Mini.
- Adds configuration via .openclaw.json with support for secure API key authentication and customizable DM policies.
- Supports sending/receiving text & media, iMessage tapback reactions, group chats, and typing indicators.
- Includes agent tools and slash commands for checking status and switching messaging services.
- Public links to docs, support, issues, and npm package included.
